thread:
mia-cs: heads up — FinancialFlow called out rising inference spend and a couple of "entity normalization" regressions on /assist. Renewal in ~6w and health is drifting orange. Thinking: small, low-risk play: intent routing + compact model for FAQ + int8 candidate behind a canary. ok to proceed?
ken-ml: sounds reasonable. Their traffic is ~68% short Q/A, ~14% long summaries. Cost and p95 tail dominated by the Q/A hot path. Compact+int8 should materially cut spend; need entity-preserve checks.
tara-se: agree. Proposed routing: intent:faq -> redwood/ff-compact-qa-int8, intent:summary -> redwood/ppx-4.2-fp. Canary phases: 3% -> 20% -> 60% over 48h with automated gates.
sam: customer feedback: "snappier replies but some account IDs lose formatting". They want an objective eval before >20% traffic. Add to playbook.
ken-ml: eval plan: assemble 500 anonymized examples focusing on account IDs, tickers, and invoice refs. Metrics: entity_F1, formatting_preserve_rate, latency_p95, cost_per_1k_tokens. Gates: formatting_preserve_rate >= 0.99 AND entity_F1 >= prod - 1.0%. Fallback: auto-rollback to FP if entity_F1 drops >1.5% in a rolling 60m.
tara-se: routing snippet (pseudo):
```yaml
routes:
  - match: "intent:faq"
    model: "redwood/ff-compact-qa-int8"
    weight: 0.03
  - match: "intent:summary"
    model: "redwood/ppx-4.2"
    weight: 0.97
rollout:
  phases: ["15m","6h","48h"]
  metrics_gate: "formatting_preserve_rate >= 0.99 AND entity_F1 >= prod - 0.01"
fallback:
  on_metric_drop: "switch_to_fp_for_customer(financialflow)"
```
mia-cs: good. ballpark savings if FAQ path moves to compact-int8?
ken-ml: rough estimate: 30-36% token cost reduction on FAQ traffic, overall monthly spend down ~15% given their mix. latency p95 improvement on faq path ~25-35%. int8 adds ~8-10% more savings but watch small accuracy delta (~0.5%).
sam: flagged FinancialFlow for eval-set sign-off and rollback bounds. They want a small UX A/B of 200 users to check visible formatting before large cutover.
alert-bot: ticket created: CS-4001 "FinancialFlow compact+quant routing pilot" assigned to @ken-ml,@tara-se,@mia-cs due 2026-08-01. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4001 :rotating_light:
mia-cs: next steps: ken run eval and post numbers + counterexamples, tara prepare canary script + route, sam get customer's sign-off on eval set and A/B cohort. i'll draft renewal messaging after initial canary results. :thumbsup:
